description: This file defines a class 'TableOfContentsRenderer' responsible for rendering a Table of Contents macro in Confluence format using PHP, integrating with the League\CommonMark library for Markdown processing.

classes.name: TableOfContentsRenderer
classes.description: A class implementing NodeRendererInterface that renders a Table of Contents macro for Confluence.
